title: The Blood-Testing Startup Founded By Elizabeth Holmes’ Partner
summary: Billy Evans’ startup Haemanthus says it’s not “Theranos 2.0.” But reporting by Forbes on cofounders Lauren Friedman Stat, a Palantir board member and longtime friend of Holmes, and her physician husband David Stat, raises questions.
